data.body: AC5 red-before-change evidence. tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_closure.py run against origin/main e1c9eb09fa3 with det_closure absent: 7 failed, 3 passed. Failing: test_omitted_doc_path_named_for_required_empty_grep, test_omitted_path_named_for_removed_symbol_without_grep_ac, test_omitted_path_names_the_matched_text_of_an_over_matching_regex, test_omitted_path_found_in_a_plain_snapshot_tree (AC1); test_covered_enumeration_emits_nothing (AC2, KeyError closure_sources); test_module_deletion_names_remaining_tests_in_bound_test_file (AC3); test_uncompilable_grep_pattern_abstains_and_is_counted. The 3 that pass red are negative properties (nothing emitted / command never executed), true vacuously before the lint exists. After the change: 11 passed (a pathspec-exclusion test was added). Real-tree check: on dc42's plan against e2ed08b343a^ the lint names 6+ un-enumerated paths that the landed commit did edit (README.plan-review.md, provider_parity.py, container_stage.py, gate_dispatch.py, lint.py, lint_expr.py), plus false positives where a removal sentence names a symbol the story keeps. Known limit: path granularity, so the 596b miss (an extra line in an already-enumerated file) is not reported.
